data.narrative:
Planted Solar is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $32M to date. The valuation analysis is grounded in a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Lonza, ticker LNZA) operating in the Climate & Energy sector. Notable private peers include Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

A Stage-Progression methodology is applicable here, using the $32M total raised as a proxy for current implied value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression. This yields an implied valuation of $64M. A Peer-Median approach was not viable given insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector—while 9 same-sector peers exist, none of the narrow stage and valuation-tier filters produced the required minimum of three datapoints. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce material noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $54M (low) to $74M (high), with a median of $64M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the thinness of the comparable set—with only one public reference point and no directly analogous Series A peers in the data—and the reliance on a single applicable methodology. Any refinement would require closer visibility into deal economics and revenue trajectories relative to named private peers.
